name: deck.gl
category: A9. Adjacent resources mentioned during discovery
role: WebGL layers for large geospatial and point-cloud data; view state as props
summary: WebGL2/WebGPU visualisation framework layering scatterplots, arcs, hexbins, trips and 3D tiles over maps or a plain canvas. Everything is declarative props, so animating means setting props or viewState from t and capturing the canvas. Distinguishing strength: GPU rendering of very large geospatial datasets with built-in map projections.
use_when: Over D3 when data is geospatial or too large for SVG
Camera fly-throughs over maps by animating viewState from t
Over Three.js when you want ready-made data layers, not custom meshes
avoid_when: Small charts and diagrams: D3 is simpler and vector-friendly

assessment.rationale: Actively maintained (9.4.0 Sep 2026). Only catalogued tool for GPU layers over maps and million-point geospatial data; D3 is SVG/canvas and vtk-js is scientific. View state is a plain prop, so frames can be driven by t.
